hero.eyebrow: Vietnamese esoteric library · One way in for every question
hero.lead: You read a chart full of unfamiliar terms and still can't tell what it says about you? Lá Số Việt builds a free Zi Wei chart, then opens each insight with one question: why does it say that.
hero.copy: No single verdict for you to guess at. No promise to know the future. Important insights can be opened — which data, which rule, what limit — so the final call stays yours.
hero.microcopy: Free to start · Private by default · No account required.

problem.title: Ever read a horoscope and wondered why it fit someone else but not you?
problem.lead: The answer usually comes down to scope and presentation, not who is more skilled.

point1.title: Different scope
point1.copy: Each framework — Zi Wei, BaZi, astrology — looks at its own structure and answers its own set of questions, not your whole life in one line.

point2.title: Different language
point2.copy: Classical terms need someone to translate them into how people actually talk today — otherwise you just hear the sound, not the meaning.

point3.title: Hard to compare
point3.copy: An insight is only truly useful when you can see the data and the rule behind it, not just hear the conclusion and take it on faith.

problem.bridge: Lá Số Việt starts with Zi Wei: it builds your actual chart first, then opens each insight so you can check it yourself — instead of handing down one verdict and stopping there.

valueLadder.title: No single verdict for you to guess at
valueLadder.bodyIntro: A Zi Wei chart has dozens of palaces, stars, and relationships. We don't compress all of it into one generic line. Each insight comes with its own "why" so you can check it yourself.

ai.question: Does Lá Số Việt use AI?
ai.answer: Yes. AI helps organize and interpret within the available evidence; it does not replace the underlying calculation data and rules.

time.question: What if I do not know my exact birth time?
time.answer: You can save your birth data even without knowing the exact time. If you know a rough birth-hour range (by the 12 Earthly Branches) or the exact time, a Zi Wei chart can still be built. If the time is completely unknown, we say plainly what can't be calculated instead of picking a time for you.

payment.question: Do paid reports renew automatically?
payment.answer: No. The displayed price is a one-time payment with no automatic renewal.

privacy.question: How is my birth data used?
privacy.answer: In the current flow, birth data is used to create the chart and interpretation. Charts are private by default, and available controls let you view, correct, or delete data.
